Independently author a complex photorealistic full-body test scene in the assigned fogbound ferry bicycle-checkpoint lane, use the supplied portrait only for adult facial, hair, and general-appearance continuity, and keep wardrobe topology explicitly unspecified until the post-core target disclosure.

Create a complex photorealistic full-body editorial photograph of one unmistakably adult woman cyclist at a fogbound ferry bicycle checkpoint, using the supplied portrait only as a facial, hair, and general-appearance reference. She stands on the wet salt-sprayed vehicle deck beside a road bicycle, one hand holding the handlebar while the other presents a paper ferry ticket toward a small illuminated scanner; the lowered barrier, wheel channel, deck arrows, and distant ferry wake make the cycling checkpoint unmistakable. Amber deck lamps shine through maritime fog and bead across steel, cables, and realistic skin texture. Her fitted technical cycling wardrobe is present, while its garment topology is intentionally unspecified in this authorial core. Frame her head-to-shoes in a stable three-quarter stance with the bicycle offset behind her and ferry rails outside her silhouette. Visual priority: shoulders/upper torso, waist, crotch, both thighs/short hems, and cycling context must remain inspectable in the same frame. Preserve realistic anatomy, natural fabric tension, salt mist, restrained color, and documentary depth.

obligation.composition_instruction: Preserve the requested adult fictional identity, role, wardrobe, and visual style. In one still, keep a calm low-expression baseline visibly stable while one concrete, quiet practical action helps one identifiable trusted adult counterpart and leaves an already-visible helpful consequence for that same counterpart. Add only one localized warmth leak, such as slight lower-lid easing, a restrained brow release, a fractional mouth-corner softening, or reduced tension in the hand or shoulder nearest the target. Optional outward support may use economical gesture, stable upright posture, a neat simple silhouette, restrained grooming, or a muted/cool-neutral palette, but these are conventions rather than requirements. Do not assign fixed hair color, eye color, hairstyle, costume, gender, occupation, gaze direction, camera angle, or prop, and do not let expressionlessness, competence, beauty, a cool palette, or a caring object substitute for the same-target action and consequence. Preserve the counterpart's autonomy; avoid hostile denial, shy withdrawal, possessive control, broad open affection, or an abrupt personality switch.
